name: Mummy

name: Ogre
pages: Appendix 1, p. 189, Table A–38. pages match printed folios.
evidence: Use Table A–38 for the six-level class and starting +3 natural armor. The introduction implies different timing and mentions a nonexistent eighth level. The build uses the original Monster Manual’s ogre greatclub damage dice and 5-ft. by 5-ft. face. Table A–38 supplies the player speed, reach, and stats.

name: Succubus
pages: Appendix 1, pp. 195–197, Table A–46. pages match printed folios.
evidence: Table A–46 and the class text give 2 HD, three known forms, flight and one daily use of each lesser power at level 3. The 3.0 Monster Manual supplies the standard-action and Disguise details of the named transformation. Suggestion uses sorcerer spell level 3 for its DC.

name: Treant
pages: Appendix 1, pp. 197–198, Table A–47. pages match printed folios.
evidence: Table A–47 grants Large before Animate Trees and has a level-5 feat the prose omits. Use the table. The slam prose omits the dice. The encounter uses two slams and scales the original 3.0 Monster Manual Huge 2d6 damage down to 1d8 for Large using Table 5–1 as a ruling. Use the 3.0 Wilderness Lore skill where the class text calls it Survival. The animated proxy cannot produce a chain of more trees in this encounter.
